# IContentContainer

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

A slot that can hold a single child element. All fluent extension methods operate on this interface. This is the core of the BonniePDF fluent API chain pattern.

Namespace `BonniePDF.Fluent`.
